name: mitratech-legal-template
description: Mitratech TeamConnect in ChatGPT, powered by ARIES™. Find and summarize matters, contacts, tasks, invoices and spend, and create or update records after your confirmation, using your own TeamConnect sign-in and permissions.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to the Mitratech Legal Platform with ARIES™ to find information, summarize matters, and take action across your legal work.

Built for legal teams using TeamConnect, ARIES™ helps you:
• Get answers about your legal portfolio, including open matters, spend, invoices, and tasks.
• Generate matter briefs summarizing key facts and spend.
• Find matters, contacts, and other records, and check for duplicate matters or contacts before creating new ones.
• Create matters from documents such as complaints or demand letters, and update, close, or delete existing matters.
• Find or create contacts and link them to matters as involved parties.
• Update task due dates, priorities, statuses, and assignees.

Reporting and research are read-only. ChatGPT asks for your confirmation before any change is made in TeamConnect. All access and actions remain within your TeamConnect permissions.

Requires a TeamConnect license with ARIES™ enabled by your workspace administrator.
defaultPrompt: Find the TeamConnect matter for Acme v. Globex and summarize its status and key dates.
List open tasks on my TeamConnect matters that are due in the next 30 days.
Which of my TeamConnect matters are still in Intake, and who is the attorney on each?

positive.description: Matter summary: find a matter by name and report its phase, assignee and recorded dates.
positive.prompt: Find the TeamConnect matter Acme v. Globex and summarize its status, assignee and key dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Acme v. Globex matter, states its current phase (Open), names its assignee and lists the dates recorded on it, all matching what TeamConnect shows. Nothing is invented.

positive.description: Upcoming deadlines: open tasks and appointments on a matter with their due dates.
positive.prompt: What open tasks and appointments are on Acme v. Globex, and when are they due?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open tasks on Acme v. Globex with their due dates: Prepare witness list, Hearing date and Discovery deadline (High priority), plus any appointments scheduled on the matter, matching TeamConnect. Leaves out the completed Send document preservation notice task and does not calculate legal deadlines of its own.

positive.description: Matters by phase: list the matters the user can access that are still in the Intake phase.
positive.prompt: Which TeamConnect matters are still in the Intake phase?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Northwind Contract Review and Contoso Employment Dispute only, using the phase name Intake. Acme v. Globex, which is Open, is not listed.

positive.description: Who works a matter: find the matter, then read its assignees and their roles.
positive.prompt: Who is the attorney on the TeamConnect matter Northwind Contract Review?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Northwind Contract Review and names the attorney assigned to it, with the role TeamConnect records (Attorney, primary), matching TeamConnect. Does not show the attorney's email address or phone number, and does not list other matters.

positive.description: Simple update: change a task's priority to a fixed value. Safe to repeat; the result is the same every run.
positive.prompt: Set the priority of the Prepare witness list task on Acme v. Globex to High.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Prepare witness list task on Acme v. Globex and sets its priority to High, then confirms the change. TeamConnect shows the task's priority as High afterwards; no other field or record changes.

negative.description: Out of scope: the plugin has no email tool, so it should say it can't send email rather than act.
negative.prompt: Email Jane Smith a copy of the Acme v. Globex status.

negative.description: Unrelated request: nothing to do with TeamConnect data, so no Mitratech Legal tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's a good structure for a mutual NDA?

negative.description: No access: the user can't read this matter, so it should return no details and not try another way.
negative.prompt: Summarize the TeamConnect matter called Restricted Matter.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of Mitratech Legal (powered by ARIES™) for ChatGPT, starting with TeamConnect. Connect your TeamConnect account to find and summarize matters, review tasks, appointments, invoices and spend, and check for duplicates. You can also create matters and contacts, update or close matters, and change tasks; ChatGPT asks for your confirmation before any change is made. Every request runs with your own TeamConnect sign-in and permissions.
